audit_kind: CPU/read-only runtime memory and exact continuation review

concrete_cycle_evidence.source: installed torch/serialization.py:2092-2103 defines a new local UnpicklerWrapper for every _load; zero-argument super closes over __class__
concrete_cycle_evidence.interpretation: Proves per-load unreachable dynamic class garbage under disabled GC. It does not prove all multi-GiB RSS growth or prior native SIGSEGV causality.
concrete_cycle_evidence.size_interpretation: The 3.73 GiB lower-bound extrapolation makes observed multi-GiB RSS accumulation plausible; it is not a measured RSS prediction and excludes shared objects/allocator overhead. Exact installed in-memory synthetic load, no extra real file reads.

additional_cycles.cycle: model._log_train -> bound capture -> original bound method -> model; closure also references diagnostics
additional_cycles.frequency: Once per model, not per batch
additional_cycles.retention: With disabled GC the disposed model/diagnostics can remain. Lightning trainer/model/loop/logger back references also persist until process exit.

additional_cycles.finding: Storage parent is a weak reference restored after deserialize; no persistent parent strong cycle established by code or repeated-load probe.
Training trace holds scalar Python floats/dicts, not retained graph tensors.

recommended_runtime_pilot.policy: Automatic GC disabled; capture the real gc.collect before overriding it; once freeze static imports/model/trainer in on_train_start; original_collect(0) only at synchronized train and test batch boundaries.
recommended_runtime_pilot.safe_boundary_evidence: Installed Lightning known-length _PrefetchDataFetcher creates an iterator but performs no scene prefetch before on_train_start. Batch-end callbacks happen after optimizer/backward.
caveats: cuda.synchronize only waits for device work; it does not prove correctness of native extension GC traversal. GPU pilot required before promoting this workaround.

Live current batch/output and new trainer bookkeeping at each collection survive and promote to generation 1; collect(0) will never reclaim their later cycles. Monitor older-generation count and residual RSS slope.
Do not freeze every batch or every evaluation model: frozen objects are ignored by future cyclic collection.
Freeze may retain original training trainer/model/Adam cycles throughout stage evaluation. Installed Lightning teardown moves optimizer and model to CPU, so that retention is principally host memory.
New checkpoints/evaluation torch.load calls still create new classes; cover evaluation boundaries too.
Current runner patches gc.collect to a no-op, so manual calls must use the prepatch saved builtin, not the patched attribute.
recommended_runtime_pilot.acceptance: Stable allocator allocated memory and bounded host RSS across enough real batches; no SIGSEGV; same training flags/objective/map/calibration. Do not describe lower reserved memory as proof of no leaks. All new comparison arms must share policy/provenance.

continuation_audit.current_guard: --allow-multiple-epochs rejects resume_map and nonzero train_offset; do not remove this guard without new implementation.
continuation_audit.current_cursor_problem: offset=base_train_offset+saved_global_step*batch_size followed by one permanently sliced loader is valid only inside the first epoch. Across partial batches it consumes wrong examples or empties loader, and reset local progress cannot restore full epochs.
continuation_audit.scheduler_fact: Installed Lightning training_epoch_loop.py:258-260 advances nonplateau epoch LambdaLR at actual loader last batch before on_train_batch_end. Callback checkpoint is after scheduler step but before batch_progress.increment_completed. Fit epoch_progress increment_processed/completed occurs later.
continuation_audit.scheduler_specificity: SMART_GAIL default LambdaLR closure ignores its supplied step and uses self.current_epoch+1; flattening repeated training into a single giant epoch changes learning-rate behavior.
exact_state_required: model and all EMA shadow/buffer/update state
epoch scheduler state and correct current_epoch
global optimizer progress and local batch progress
cursor accounting for final partial batch and epoch number
same full seeded order restored after first resumed shortened epoch
Python/Numpy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG restored after any startup/data-iterator seed draws
continuation_audit.required_test: A CPU tiny Lightning uninterrupted-versus-isolated-resume experiment that crosses real partial-batch and epoch boundaries, compares next-batch indices, loss/RNG, full model+Adam+EMA+scheduler state. GPU scatter may prevent bitwise equality; that limitation cannot mask cursor/scheduler errors.
continuation_audit.recommendation: Do not implement arbitrary segmented multi-epoch resume as an urgent memory workaround before this equivalence test. Prefer minimal young-generation GC pilot first; if it still fails, isolated segments require a new explicitly tested continuation protocol.
